newsitem.title: ITALY: Gemina to pay 1996 ord div of 200 lire.
newsitem.headline: Gemina to pay 1996 ord div of 200 lire.

text.p: Italian financial holding group Gemina said on Tuesday it would pay an ordinary share dividend for 1996 of 200 lire per share, and a 750 lire per share dividend on its savings shares.
After a group board meeting, Gemina said that it made a 1996 net profit at the parent company level of 94 billion lire after a 185.6 billion loss in 1995.
Gemina added that the savings share dividend of 750 lire was made up of a dividend of 250 lire for 1994, 250 lire for 1995 and 250 lire for 1996.
At the consolidated level, Gemina reported a net profit of of 208.5 billion lire for 1996 after a consolidated loss in 1995 of 678.5 billion lire.

Late last year, Gemina announced the spin-off of its industrial activities into Holding di Partecipazioni Industriali SpA (HPI) which took effect from early March this year. Later the same month, HPI said it was aiming to merge with Italian textile group Marzotto.
